props.label: Every leak has a source. We find it.
props.html:
What we do

Every leak has a source. We find it.

Sydney Leak Experts is a wet-area leak detection specialist. We trace water back to exactly where it’s escaping — a shower recess, a balcony membrane, a pool shell, a roof — and prove it with a clear report.

Because we lead with moisture mapping and thermal imaging, most leaks are found with no demolition at all. And because detection is all we do, we recognise the patterns a general trade would miss.

  • Wet areas only — not gas, drains or pipe work.
  • Non-invasive first — the source before anything is opened up.
  • Clear reports — ready for strata, insurers and builders.

props.label: Leak detection in Sydney — FAQs
props.html:
Questions, answered

Leak detection in Sydney — FAQs

What is wet-area leak detection?
It’s locating water escaping from the wet areas of a building — showers, bathrooms, balconies, pools, roofs and the ceilings and walls they affect — using non-invasive tools rather than demolition. It’s what we specialise in; we’re not a plumber.
What kinds of leaks do you detect?
Shower and bathroom, balcony and terrace, pool, roof, ceiling and wall leaks, plus water damage and mould, strata and apartment leaks, and documented reports. We don’t do gas, blocked drains or CCTV pipe work.
Do you cover my part of Sydney?
We service all of Greater Sydney — from the Inner West and Eastern Suburbs to the Northern Beaches, North Shore, Hills, Sutherland Shire and the west.
How much does leak detection cost?
Our first hour on site is $299 inc GST, confirmed as a fixed price before we start.

props.label: A clear price before we start.
props.html:
Upfront pricing

A clear price before we start.

Most inspections start at a fixed first-hour rate. These are the things that move the number:

Where the leak isHigh impact

A shower recess, a balcony membrane and a pool shell are very different jobs to access and trace.

Access to the areaHigh impact

Tiles, render, slabs and tight cavities take longer to read than an open, visible surface.

How hidden it isMedium impact

A visible drip is quick; a leak behind finished surfaces needs thermal imaging and more time.

Report requirementsMedium impact

A documented strata or insurance report with photos and cause takes more time than a verbal result.

Time & urgencyLow impact

After-hours and weekend call-outs for an active leak carry a set surcharge.

We lead with non-invasive methods — moisture mapping, thermal imaging and targeted testing — to locate the source before anything is opened up.
What areas can you inspect?
Showers, bathrooms, balconies, terraces, pools, roofs and the ceilings and walls they affect — wet areas across Greater Sydney. We don’t do gas, blocked drains or CCTV pipe work.
Will I get a report?
Yes — clear findings with the location, likely cause and recommended next step, documented for insurance or strata when you need it.
